test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something
solution:
The solution is **Optimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for "A person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something" is Optimist.

 
 
• *For example: Only an eternal **optimist **could expect success.*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:

 
 
• ​**Fanatic** - A person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause.
 
• **Pessimist** - A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
 
• **Opportunist **- A person who takes advantage of opportunities as and when they arise, regardless of planning or principle.
